description: Use this when the user wants guests to RSVP to an event: it publishes a shared web page where guests answer Yes/No/Maybe, add plus-ones and answer one optional multiple-choice question (for example meal choice). Returns a guest link to share and a private organizer link for results. Needs the title, start (local date-time) and IANA time zone. The event must end within 105 days. Does not send invitations, emails or reminders, and does not sell tickets or take payments.

allow_maybe.description: Offer a Maybe answer as well as Yes and No. Default true. Example: false.

end.description: Optional end: HH:MM on the same day (e.g. 23:00; an earlier time means the next day), a local date-time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or for an all-day event the last day YYYY-MM-DD.

host_name.description: Host display name shown to guests, e.g. Sam.

location.description: Place as plain text, e.g. Luigi's, 12 Main St, back room. Links are not allowed.

max_extra_guests.description: How many extra guests (plus-ones) one reply may bring, 0-10. Default 0. Example: 2.

note.description: Short note for guests, e.g. Dress code smart casual. Parking at the back.

question.description: Optional one multiple-choice question for guests who answer Yes, e.g. Meal choice.

question_options.description: 2-8 answer choices for the question, e.g. ["Chicken", "Fish", "Vegetarian"].

rsvp_deadline.description: Optional last day to reply, YYYY-MM-DD (end of that day) or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, in the event's time zone, e.g. 2026-11-14.

start.description: Start as local date and time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the event's time zone, e.g. 2026-11-21T19:00. Use a date YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the event, e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Bangkok. Abbreviations such as EST are refused.

title.description: Event name shown as the page title, e.g. Maya's 30th birthday dinner.
